structural_change: d4g GEN1 HC ROOT (instance hc_eng; l3_vm_hc_coll.py remaster ot_hbm_hc_eng_static -> ot_hbm_hc_root_static, QDRLY 2 = U-ring hub DRLY 2 (HBM-RTL5/hc 0fi), XRD = XRU = 0 until the relay layer stations the root <-> hub links). Programme/table F20 targets 164/165, ot_hbm_hc_eng_seq_static, HCP core ot_hdc_v41x_hcp_sys1_static SYS 1 TPRE 6 (partial-sum tree root ((q0+q1)+(q2+q3)) over the 4 quarter sums), 6,144-b mix store, bases/scales table (1 x 1024x256 SRAM, W beside the F20 pins), 2 exact tail units, 3,072-b result pins. No lane datapath (moved to the 4 quarter engines). Slot: the d4g grant hc_eng (5,223 x 1,953 um at the S edge) is the retired full-engine slot; this root is 648 x 648 (15 x 43.2) and belongs at the centre between the 4 hce_<q> quarters.
